summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 skill-input remains historical and cannot become v2 authority automatically; v2 assigns explicit roles, with only normative, authority, and implementation inputs authorizing; selection and content hashes are independent; selection binds roles, repo-relative paths, modules, scope, resources; adapter owns transport, paging, continuation, coverage, truncation; ready receipts require immutable generations under binding-hash and validated atomic current pointer; consumers use pointer only; execution, publication, semantic-review gates are independent; knowledge self-change derives from changed-set and canonical path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers before 8-18 creates new current receipt; historical current directories remain immutable until approved retention; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
